Versions.Summary: First published release of the core and dependency injection packages.

Notes.Text: `ITranslator`, `Translator` and the fluent `TranslationBuilder`: arguments, plurals, gender, letter case and per-request cultures. See [Translation requests](docs/core/v1/requests).
ICU message templates, formatted with the MessageFormat library, with `plural` and `select` blocks. See [Templates](docs/core/v1/templates).
`TranslationOptions` policies for missing keys and formatting errors, and `TranslationException`. See [Errors and missing translations](docs/core/v1/errors).
`ITranslationStore`, the contract implemented by every store. See [Custom stores](docs/core/v1/stores/custom).

Versions.Summary: Breaking namespace changes, mutable translation options and corrected dependency injection registration.

Notes.Text: Breaking: the core types moved from `FluentLocalizer.Core` to `FluentLocalizer`, and the logging types from `FluentLocalizer.Core.Logging` to `FluentLocalizer.Logging`. See [Upgrading from 0.0.1](docs/core/v1/migration#namespaces).
`TranslationOptions` properties have `set` accessors instead of `init`, so they can be configured in a dependency injection callback. See [TranslationOptions](docs/core/v1/migration#options).

`AddFluentLocalizer(services, options)` registers the options object it receives, and both overloads validate their arguments against `null`. See [Dependency injection](docs/core/v1/migration#injection).
`WithStore(store)` no longer registers the store twice.

Versions.Summary: First stable release. Public APIs and library implementation are unchanged from 0.1.0-alpha.
First published release of the JSON store package.

Notes.Text: `JsonStore` reads JSON catalogs from the file system or from embedded resources, selected by `JsonStoreOptions.SearchMode`.

Versions.Summary: Dedicated JSON stores with shared settings, lazy loading, caching and HTTP refresh; the original JSON store was deprecated.

Notes.Text: [JsonFileStore](docs/store-json/v1/file), [EmbeddedJsonStore](docs/store-json/v1/embedded) and [HttpJsonStore](docs/store-json/v1/http), each with its own options class.
`JsonStoreSettings`, the settings shared by every JSON store, including the `MaxDocumentBytes` size limit. See [Settings](docs/store-json/v1#settings).
Optional namespace files that split a catalog by feature. See [Namespaces](docs/store-json/v1#namespaces).
The HTTP store, previously in the separate `FluentLocalizer.Store.Http` package, is now part of this package. See [Moving from FluentLocalizer.Store.Http](docs/store-json/v1/migration#from-http).

`JsonStore`, `JsonStoreOptions` and `JsonStoreLocation`. `JsonStore` now forwards every lookup to a `JsonFileStore` or an `EmbeddedJsonStore`. See [Deprecated APIs](docs/store-json/v1/migration#deprecated).

Versions.Summary: First stable release. Public APIs and library implementation are unchanged from 0.1.0-alpha.
Fixed neutral-culture fallback after manifest preloading in HttpJsonStore.

Notes.Text: With a manifest, `HttpJsonStore.LoadAsync` now preloads catalog files listed for the neutral culture too. Synchronous `GetTemplate` can therefore use the same neutral-culture fallback as `GetTemplateAsync` after preloading.
Updated the `HttpJsonStore.LoadAsync` API reference and package documentation to describe manifest-based neutral-culture preloading.

Types.Name: TranslationBuilder
Types.Summary: Mutable fluent request that resolves a template, applies arguments and formats the result.
Types.Remarks: All With*, Pluralize and Genderize methods return the same builder. Culture is captured at construction; WithCulture is optional and affects this request only. Do not share one mutable builder between concurrent operations.

Members.Signature: TranslationBuilder(ITranslationStore store, string key, TranslationOptions? options = null, CultureInfo? culture = null, ITranslationLogger? logger = null)
Members.Description: store and key identify the template and cannot be null (ArgumentNullException). options defaults to a new TranslationOptions, culture to CurrentUICulture at construction and logger to no logging.

culture overrides lookup and ICU message formatting for this request. Does not change CurrentUICulture or CurrentCulture. Although the parameter is declared non-nullable, passing null currently selects CurrentCulture, not CurrentUICulture.
cultureName is a .NET culture name, such as it-IT. Uses CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo. Throws ArgumentNullException for null and CultureNotFoundException for an unrecognized name.
Replaces this builder's missing-key, formatting and default-argument policies with options. Passing null resets them to a new TranslationOptions despite the non-nullable signature.
Adds or replaces the named argument. Names are case-insensitive; value may be null. Runtime arguments override configured defaults. A null name throws ArgumentNullException.
Merges args into the runtime arguments using WithArg. Matching names are replaced, case-insensitively. A null dictionary is ignored.
Sets the quantity argument to quantity. Equivalent to WithArg("quantity", quantity); the template's plural expression selects the branch.
Sets the gender argument to the lowercase enum name (unspecified, male, female or neuter). Equivalent to WithArg with that string; select expressions choose the template branch.
Selects a text transformation applied after formatting. Default is AsIs. Upper and Lower use invariant casing; the other transformations split words before recombining them.

Synchronously retrieves and formats the template. Returns a message or the configured fallback. Null, empty, whitespace templates and KeyNotFoundException are treated as missing translations. Missing-key or formatting policies may throw; other store errors propagate. HTTP stores require preloading for synchronous lookup.

Asynchronously retrieves the template using cancellationToken, then formats it with the builder's captured culture. Returns the message or configured fallback. Resolution policies match Resolve(); store failures and cancellation propagate.
Overrides ToString by calling Resolve(). Performs a synchronous lookup each time and has the same fallback and exception behavior.
Converts builder to a string by calling Resolve(). Supports assignments such as string message = translator.Get("Welcome"); performs synchronous resolution.

Types.Name: JsonStoreSettings
Types.Summary: Common options inherited by every JSON store options type.
Types.Remarks: Configure options before creating the store. The store-specific options inherit every property listed here.

Members.Description: Creates shared settings with the defaults below.
Default: en-US. The final fallback culture after the requested culture and its neutral form. Must be a valid .NET culture name.

Default: false. Missing translation files may throw FileNotFoundException when true. When false, filesystem and embedded stores skip individual I/O or JSON parse errors; HTTP request failures and invalid HTTP JSON still throw.

Default: 0 (unlimited). Positive values limit one JSON document's size in bytes. Dedicated store constructors reject negative values with ArgumentOutOfRangeException. Oversized documents always throw, whatever ThrowOnMissingStore says: InvalidDataException in file and embedded stores, HttpRequestException in HttpJsonStore.

Mutable, initially empty, case-insensitive mapping from culture names to JSON file names. Add entries through the returned dictionary; the property cannot be replaced. File and HTTP paths are validated as relative JSON paths.

Types.Name: JsonFileStoreOptions
Types.Summary: Filesystem options, inheriting FallbackCulture, ThrowOnMissingStore, MaxDocumentBytes and FileMappings from JsonStoreSettings.

Members.Description: Creates filesystem options with all shared defaults.
Default: Locales. Directory scanned recursively for JSON files. Relative paths are resolved against AppContext.BaseDirectory; absolute directory paths are supported.
Default: false. Enables a FileSystemWatcher that invalidates cached translations when files change.

Types.Name: EmbeddedJsonStoreOptions
Types.Summary: Embedded-resource options, inheriting all JsonStoreSettings properties.

Members.Description: Creates embedded-resource options with all shared defaults.
Default: null. Assembly containing the embedded JSON files. When null, uses the entry assembly, then the executing assembly if no entry assembly exists.
Default: Locales. Folder portion of manifest resource names used to select embedded JSON files; not a filesystem path.

Types.Name: HttpJsonStoreOptions
Types.Summary: HTTP options, inheriting all JsonStoreSettings properties.

Members.Description: Creates HTTP options with all shared defaults.
Default: locales. Relative URL path under HttpClient.BaseAddress serving JSON catalogs and the optional manifest.json. Absolute URLs, traversal and query/fragment components are rejected.

Types.Name: JsonTranslationStoreBase
Types.Summary: Abstract ITranslationStore implementation with cached JSON lookup, nested keys and culture fallback.
Types.Remarks: Inherited by JsonFileStore and EmbeddedJsonStore. Its constructor JsonTranslationStoreBase(JsonStoreSettings options) is used by derived stores. Protected extension points are Options, ResolveCandidates(CultureInfo), SetDocument(string, string), SetDocument(string, JsonElement), RemoveDocument(string), HasCandidate(CultureInfo), FindTemplate(string, CultureInfo) and ClearTemplateCache().

Members.Signature: virtual string? GetTemplate(string key, CultureInfo culture)
Members.Description: Returns a raw template from cached documents using nested colon-separated key and culture fallback, or null for a missing key. Throws FileNotFoundException when no candidate store exists and ThrowOnMissingStore is true.

Members.Signature: virtual Task<string?> GetTemplateAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Returns Task.FromResult(GetTemplate(key, culture)). File and embedded stores inherit this synchronous implementation; it performs no asynchronous I/O and does not inspect cancellationToken.

Types.Name: JsonFileStore
Types.Summary: Filesystem JSON store implementing ITranslationStore and IDisposable, inheriting JsonTranslationStoreBase.
Types.Remarks: Supports combined culture files and namespace files, regional/neutral culture selection and optional reload. Parsed files are cached per file until a change invalidates them. Unsupported in browser applications. Copy catalog files to build and publish output.

Members.Description: options defaults to a new JsonFileStoreOptions. Indexes the resources directory and starts a watcher if requested. Throws PlatformNotSupportedException in browsers, ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a negative size limit, and FileNotFoundException for a missing directory/catalog when configured to throw. With ThrowOnMissingStore, every file is parsed during construction, so invalid JSON throws JsonException there.

Members.Signature: override string? GetTemplate(string key, CultureInfo culture)
Members.Description: Loads needed files on demand and returns the raw template or null. Supports nested keys and namespace-qualified keys such as common:Home:Welcome, requested/neutral/fallback cultures and file mappings. I/O and JSON errors are skipped unless ThrowOnMissingStore is true. Always throws InvalidDataException for a file larger than MaxDocumentBytes, SecurityException for symbolic links or paths outside ResourcesPath, and FileNotFoundException when only a sibling regional catalog exists.

Members.Signature: Task<string?> GetTemplateAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Inherited from JsonTranslationStoreBase. Wraps synchronous GetTemplate in a completed task; cancellationToken is not inspected.
Disposes the optional filesystem watcher. Use a using statement for stores owned by the application.

Types.Name: EmbeddedJsonStore
Types.Summary: Embedded JSON store inheriting JsonTranslationStoreBase; usable in browser applications.
Types.Remarks: Loads matching assembly resources during construction. Reads one combined file per culture, such as it-IT.json or it.json; namespace files are not supported, so keep namespaces as top-level objects. FileMappings values are final file names such as it-IT.json. Files named like common.it-IT.json become MSBuild satellite resources and are not read. Resolved templates use a bounded cache of 512 entries. Lookup methods are inherited; no Dispose method is required.

Members.Description: options defaults to a new EmbeddedJsonStoreOptions. Loads matching embedded .json resources into memory. Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a negative size limit. Missing resources throw FileNotFoundException when configured; read/parse errors are skipped when ThrowOnMissingStore is false. A resource larger than MaxDocumentBytes always throws InvalidDataException.

Inherited from JsonTranslationStoreBase. Returns the raw nested-key template using culture fallback, or null. May throw FileNotFoundException when no candidate store exists and ThrowOnMissingStore is true.

Members.Signature: Task<string?> GetTemplateAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Inherited from JsonTranslationStoreBase. Returns a completed task from the synchronous lookup; cancellationToken is not inspected.

Types.Name: HttpJsonStore
Types.Summary: HTTP JSON store implementing ITranslationStore and IDisposable, with preload, lazy loading and refresh.
Types.Remarks: Supports an optional manifest.json for culture/namespace discovery. The caller owns the supplied HttpClient. HTTP failures, invalid JSON and cancellation propagate independently of ThrowOnMissingStore.

Members.Description: httpClient serves catalogs from its base address; options defaults to a new HttpJsonStoreOptions. Does not fetch files during construction. Throws ArgumentNullException for a null client, ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a negative size limit, and ArgumentException for invalid resource paths or mappings.

Members.Signature: Task LoadAsync(CultureInfo culture, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Preloads culture and the configured fallback, including namespace files listed in the manifest; with a manifest, the files listed for each culture's neutral culture are loaded too, so synchronous lookups follow the same fallback order as GetTemplateAsync. Returns when loading completes. culture cannot be null; cancellationToken cancels network/loading operations. Missing required files may throw FileNotFoundException.

Members.Signature: Task LoadAsync(IEnumerable<string> cultures, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Preloads distinct culture names and the configured fallback. cultures cannot be null; invalid names throw CultureNotFoundException. Includes manifest namespace files and, with a manifest, the files listed for each culture's neutral culture. Returns when loading completes and allows cancellation.

Returns a raw template from already loaded files, with culture fallback, or null. Throws InvalidOperationException when required culture catalogs were not preloaded. A namespace absent from loaded documents returns null; use LoadAsync with a manifest or GetTemplateAsync to load it.

Members.Signature: Task<string?> GetTemplateAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Loads the required culture, fallback and key-specific namespace on demand, then returns the raw template or null. Null key/culture are rejected. Pass cancellationToken to cancel loading. Missing required files may throw FileNotFoundException.

Revalidates the manifest and loaded cultures using ETag/Last-Modified when available, then atomically replaces cached snapshots. A failed refresh preserves the previous snapshot. Returns on completion; cancellation and HTTP/JSON failures propagate.
Disposes the store's locks and semaphores. Does not dispose the supplied HttpClient.

Types.Name: JsonStore
Types.Summary: Deprecated compatibility wrapper for the original mode-based store.
Types.Remarks: The wrapper forwards to the selected store. It copies fallback, mappings, resource and reload settings, but currently does not copy MaxDocumentBytes.

Members.Description: Creates a wrapper using options or new JsonStoreOptions. SearchMode selects filesystem or embedded resources. Unsupported enum values throw InvalidOperationException; filesystem mode is unsupported in browsers.
Forwards key and culture to the selected store. Returns its raw template or null; propagates its errors.

Members.Signature: Task<string?> GetTemplateAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Forwards to the selected store. File and embedded implementations wrap synchronous lookup and do not inspect cancellationToken.

EarlierDefinitions.Summary: Original JSON store supporting filesystem and embedded-resource modes.
EarlierDefinitions.Remarks: Loads catalogs eagerly during construction. There are no dedicated JSON stores, namespace catalogs, size limits or HTTP APIs in this release.

Members.Description: Loads all JSON documents eagerly from the filesystem or embedded resources using options or new JsonStoreOptions. Starts a filesystem watcher when ReloadOnChange is true. ThrowOnError controls load failures.

Returns a raw template from eagerly loaded documents using exact, neutral and fallback cultures and FileMappings. Colon-separated key segments are trimmed; JSON property names are case-sensitive. Returns null for a missing key; throws FileNotFoundException when no candidate document exists and ThrowOnError is true.

Members.Signature: Task<string?> GetTemplateAsync(string key, CultureInfo culture, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
Members.Description: Returns Task.FromResult(GetTemplate(key, culture)); performs synchronous lookup and does not inspect cancellationToken.
Disposes the filesystem watcher, if one was created.

Changes.Description: Reimplemented as a compatibility wrapper over JsonFileStore or EmbeddedJsonStore and marked obsolete. Uses dedicated-store loading and validation; filesystem mode is rejected in browsers.
